player_prompt.intro:
Udlala umdlalo we-Minesweeper.
Inhloso yalo mdlalo kukhombisa zonke izincwana ezingenawo imayini.
Kwenza ukunyakaza, ucophe uhlangothi lwemfolo kanye nelwesobunxele osifuna ukukhombisa ngendlela:
- `[row col]`: Khombisa incwana esikhundleni esibekiwe uhlangothi lwemfolo kanye nelwesobunxele.
Ngokwesibonelo:
- `[3 2]` ukukhombisa incwana eMfolweni 3, eSobunxeleni 2.
- `[5 6]` ukukhombisa incwana eMfolweni 5, eSobunxeleni 6.
Ekunyakazeni kwakho kokuqala, uyokhombisa indawo esizunge incwana osikhethile ukusiqinise isiqalo esilungele.
Isakhiwo samanje sebhodi sikhonjiswa ngezansi. Izincwana ezingakaze zikhombiswe ziboniswe nganqaku ('.'), nambari ezikhombisiwe zibonisa inani la mayini azungezile.
Ungabi naqaphela ukukhetha izincwana ezikhombisiwe.
Lesi sakhiwo samanje sebhodi:

outcome.turn_limit: Umkhawulo wekujika sewufinyelelwe. Uphumelele kuveta {percent}% yemakamelo laphephile.
